target: acceptance 4 — an unsplit irreversible spec cannot reach specd; it stays queued and the message names the split
cmd: cp "$FIXTURES/irreversible/drop_column.md" t.md; e=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" advance t.md specd 2>&1 >/dev/null); c=$?; st=$(grep -m1 "^status:" t.md | sed "s/status: //"); n=$(printf "%s" "$e" | grep -ci "expand/contract\|expand and contract"); printf '{"c":%s,"status":"%s","namesSplit":%s}' "$c" "$st" "$n"
